title: Keeping a total and best score
description: You can update two running answers in one pass through a list.

steps.description: You initialize total to zero and biggest to the first score, 88. These variables hold the answers accumulated by the loop.
Every score contributes to total. The loop visits 88, 95 and 73 in that order.

steps.question: Will visiting 73 replace biggest after the loop has seen 95?
steps.answer: No. The comparison 73 > 95 is False, so biggest remains 95.

steps.description: You see total 256, average 85.33333333333333 and highest score 95. All three prints run after the loop completes.
